items.briefing:
A reminder to be cautious when downloading files from torrent sites: cybercriminals are currently hiding malware inside torrents for popular films. If staff or family members download pirated movies this way, they risk infecting their devices with malicious software that can steal personal or work-related information. The University of Sydney has also made ChatGPT Edu available free to all its community members, which may prompt staff elsewhere to explore AI tools — a good reminder to avoid entering sensitive or confidential work information into any AI platform.

**Practical tip:** Never download pirated content, and always use only organisation-approved tools when working with sensitive information.
